event.bram_heart2.0.text: Hm. You again. You look cold. Come here. Stand where the floor's swept.
event.bram_heart2.0.why: Unaware comfort: he reads the player's state as plain cold and brings them to the fire.

event.bram_heart2.1.text: Watch the color. Cherry, not... not pale. Fire's burned pale all week.
event.bram_heart2.1.why: Frightened band: a one-word stammer, and the forge fire itself is wrong. He does not explain it.

event.bram_heart2.1.text: Watch the color. Cherry, not yellow. Fire's been sulking lately. Damp coal, maybe.
event.bram_heart2.1.why: Uneasy band: the forge burns low; he offers an ordinary reason that does not quite fit.

event.bram_heart5.1.text: You look like you slept in a ditch. Still oiled your tools. Here.
event.bram_heart5.1.why: He notices the player's tiredness and praises the care anyway; warmth intact.

event.bram_heart5.2.text: Look after them. Keep one by the bed. Iron keeps score.
event.bram_heart5.2.why: Practical comfort that lands strange: he means a tool to feel safe with, nothing more.

event.next_door.3.text: Shoulder's thin. A hair. Good tongs are on the bench. Fire's sulking. Work quick.
event.next_door.3.why: The low fire recurs from heart 2; same offer of the tongs, same meaning.

event.hall_dance.7.text: Hm. Hm-hm. Hm. ...Wrong tune. Came out on its own. Hm.
event.hall_dance.7.why: Frightened band: his hum drifts to a tune he did not choose; echoes the four notes without naming them.

event.hall_dance.7.text: Hm. Hm-hm. Hm. Sing loud, everyone. Drowns out the wind.
event.hall_dance.7.why: Hint: the night outside is felt in the warmest scene; still reads as a joke.

event.hall_dance.7.text: Hm. Hm-hm. Hm. I sing it in my own language. Louder than usual.
event.hall_dance.7.why: Uneasy band: he hums louder, a human way of keeping the dark out.

event.story_whistler_bram.intro.text: ...Hm. You're pale. How long have you been standing there?
event.story_whistler_bram.intro.why: Frightened band: he notices the player before the joke.

event.story_whistler_bram.intro.text: ...Hm. Didn't hear you. No birds tonight. How long have you been there?
event.story_whistler_bram.intro.why: Uneasy band: the quieter birds from the wakefulness ladder, noticed as weather.

event.story_whistler_bram.after.text: My teacher whistled that tune. Same wrong note. Fenn asked where I learned it. Twice.
event.story_whistler_bram.after.why: Clue: Edmund knew the tune; a curious player asks why it mattered to him.

dlg.story.band.talk.2.text: Hm. One hit. Loud. Square's been too quiet lately.
dlg.story.band.talk.2.why: Uneasy band: the hushed village, noticed by the one who likes quiet.

event.bram_heart4.intro.text: Hm. You. Hands free? Cold, too. Stand by the fire. I need two more.
event.bram_heart4.intro.why: He warms the player before putting them to work.

dlg.bram.repair.r2.text: Hm. Watch the edge, not the window. Nothing out there. Fog.
dlg.bram.repair.r2.why: Frightened band: the player keeps looking out; he redirects them, kindly and too quickly.

dlg.bram.repair.r2.text: Hm. Watch the edge, not the door. Fog's just fog.

event.bram_heart4.after.text: It'll hold. Fenn's hoe, this. Left it here last fall. Never came back.
event.bram_heart4.after.why: Clue: Edmund left a repair unfinished; he meant to return. Bram states it, never reads into it.

event.bram_heart6.after.text: That's all of it. Your turn, someday. Whatever keeps you up.
event.bram_heart6.after.why: Frightened band: having confessed, he makes room for the player's fear without asking it.

event.bram_heart6.after.text: That's all of it. Letters stay in the drawer. You should sleep more.
event.bram_heart6.after.why: Uneasy band: a blunt, kind note on the player's tiredness.

event.bram_heart8.intro.text: Hm. Juno made something. On her own. Look. Good for what ails you.
event.bram_heart8.intro.why: He offers Juno's piece as comfort; plain human care.

event.bram_heart8.after.text: I'll tell her. Today. You tell someone too. Whatever it is.
event.bram_heart8.after.why: Frightened band: he passes the courage back to the player.

event.bram_heart10.intro.text: Hm. Stand still. Breathe. Don't speak. It's easier.
event.bram_heart10.intro.why: One word added: he steadies the player before the gift.

event.bram_friend.intro.text: Hm. Wednesday. Marcus is late. Third time this month. Up all night, he says.
event.bram_friend.intro.why: Hint: a Keeper abroad at odd hours, reported as a friend's bad sleep.

event.bram_friend.doing.text: Bread's yours. All of it. You look hollow. Silence we split.
event.bram_friend.doing.why: Uneasy band: he gives up his half of the deal.

event.bram_friend.wrap.text: Good lunch. Come Wednesday. Every Wednesday. I'll keep the bread.
event.bram_friend.wrap.why: Frightened band: the joke gives way to a standing invitation.

event.bram_birthday.intro.text: Hm. Birthday. No fuss. Juno made a card. You look worn. Sit first.
event.bram_birthday.intro.why: Even on his day he notices the player first.

event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l4.text: Then peel the one off my apron. I know I'm Bram. Most mornings.
event.overheard_juno_bram_1.l4.why: Uneasy band: the village's poor sleep, as a dry joke about himself.

event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l4.text: Hm. Don't cry on the clasp. Well water rusts things fast enough.
event.overheard_juno_bram_2.l4.why: Uneasy band: wells tasting of iron, noticed by the one man who would.

event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l4.text: Hm. Take the minute. Move over. Fog's in early again.
event.overheard_juno_bram_3.l4.why: Uneasy band: the longer fog, as weather talk.

event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l2.text: Good. Make it next door. Not out by the woods. I'll visit. Daily.
event.overheard_juno_bram_4.l2.why: Hint: even the unaware keep the forge away from the wood, without saying why.

event.overheard_bram_marcus_1.l1.text: Hm. Your joint's tight. Your eyes aren't. Sleeping?
event.overheard_bram_marcus_1.l1.why: Hint: Marcus up at all hours; Bram asks as a friend.

event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l1.text: Hm. A hundred nails today. Tilda's order. Again. New moon week.
event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l1.why: Hint: the nails ordered before the new moon, from the persona's mythos note. Noticed, not explained.

event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l3.text: Mine were straighter. Yours were more. Who needs that many by the fourth?
event.overheard_bram_marcus_3.l3.why: Clue: the fourth day of the season, as an honest smith's puzzle.

event.overheard_wren_bram_3.l4.text: Hm. Don't go far. Not past the trees.
event.overheard_wren_bram_3.l4.why: Hint: a plain warning said to a Keeper; the irony is the player's, not his.

event.overheard_tilda_bram_1.l2.text: Hm. Hinges squeaked. Lamp bracket too. You burn it all night. Noticed.
event.overheard_tilda_bram_1.l2.why: Hint: Tilda's lamp, seen from the forge; his repair is still the thank-you.

adds.text: Hm. Your hands are shaking. Sit. Iron can wait.
adds.why: Fills the cut teacher line: he stops the lesson for the player.

adds.text: Hm. Somebody orders a keg of nails every new moon. Paid ahead. Odd.
adds.why: Hint: a thing to chase (who orders, and why).

adds.text: Hm. Your great-uncle bought nails four times a year. Same weeks. Never built anything.
adds.why: Clue: Edmund's four dates, seen from the forge ledger; points to the almanac margins.

adds.text: Hm. You too, [player]. Whatever's keeping you up. Sit here a while.
adds.why: Unaware comfort at the warmest moment; Juno's reply still follows naturally.

adds.text: Hm. Dorian stayed on the porch. Facing the woods. All night.
adds.why: Hint: a Keeper watching the wood, noticed by an unaware friend.

adds.text: Walk with me. Tilda's lamp is on. I'll see you that far.
adds.why: Frightened band: he walks the player toward the light; the lamp is a Keeper's tell he takes at face value.

cuts.why: The teacher reminiscence gives way to the added 'your hands are shaking' beat.

threads.bram_heart2: Who orders a keg of nails before every new moon, and why does the forge fire burn pale?
threads.bram_heart5: What did Edmund need nails for, four times a year, always the same weeks?
threads.next_door: Why is the forge fire sulking even on its best day?
threads.hall_dance: Why did Dorian spend the opening night watching the woods?
threads.story_whistler_bram: Why did Edmund care where Bram learned his teacher's tune?
threads.story_band_battle: Why has the square gone so quiet that Bram wants noise?
threads.bram_heart4: Edmund left a hoe for repair last fall; what took him away before he could fetch it?
threads.bram_heart6: Bram offers to hear what keeps the player up; what is it?
threads.bram_heart8: Bram tells the player to tell someone; who would understand?
threads.bram_heart10: Plain on purpose: only the player's breathing is noticed.
threads.bram_friend: What keeps Marcus up all night, three times a month?
threads.bram_birthday: Plain on purpose: Bram notices the player before his own day.
threads.overheard_juno_bram_1: Why does nobody in Wetherell sleep through anymore?
threads.overheard_juno_bram_2: Why is the well water rusting iron?
threads.overheard_juno_bram_3: Why does the fog come in earlier every week?
threads.overheard_juno_bram_4: Why would even Bram keep a forge away from the woods?
threads.overheard_bram_marcus_3: What does Tilda need a hundred nails for by the fourth of the season?
threads.overheard_wren_bram_3: What lies past the trees that even Bram warns Wren from?
threads.overheard_tilda_bram_1: Why does Tilda burn her lamp all night?

notes: Nails before the new moon appear three ways: an anonymous keg order (heart2 hint), Tilda's order (overheard_bram_marcus_3 hint) and Edmund's four-times-a-year purchases (heart5 clue). If Tilda should not be the named buyer, swap 'Tilda's order' for 'Big order'.
bram_heart4 clue makes the repaired hoe Edmund's, left at the forge last fall. Variant text only; no item or flag change. Check it does not clash with LORE.md.
